content:
**Civil Unrest** is a shotgun in *Fallout 76*.

Civil Unrest is a unique variant of the standard Pump Action Shotgun. Though visually identical to the standard weapon, it grants the user 10 AP when equipped, and can use the same modifications as the standard variant.
